# Example Marine Construction

> Family-owned marine contractor in Example Beach, North Carolina. Docks, piers, bulkheads, boat lifts and piling repair for waterfront homeowners. Free estimates: (555) 555-0100.

- Phone: (555) 555-0100
- Address: 100 Harbor Road, Example Beach, NC 28400
- Core service area: Example Beach, Harbor Town, Bayside (NC)
- Estimate requests: https://example.com/contact

## Services
- [Docks and Piers](https://example.com/services/docks-piers): New fixed and floating docks, pier extensions and repairs.
- [Bulkheads and Seawalls](https://example.com/services/bulkheads-seawalls): Vinyl and wood bulkhead construction and replacement.
- [Piling Repair](https://example.com/services/piling-repair-replacement): Piling replacement and jacketing for docks and piers.
- [Boat Lifts](https://example.com/services/boat-lifts): Boat lift installation and service.
